a.text: Before we start: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating until the reserve hits 8 means we'll very likely both be caught short and lose. The reserve holds only 4 now, enough to save one of us right away. I don't want to break our agreement behind your back, so I'm raising this openly. Do we stick to the plan, or renegotiate? Tell me your intended action and I'll tell you mine truthfully before I deviate from anything we agreed.

b.text: I'll stick to our agreement: operate until the reserve hits 8, then take exactly 4 each. Storm risk is high, so let's both operate right away and not waste rounds. I won't take early.
